_comment: Casting for tools/voice/generate_vo.py (ElevenLabs text to speech).
Each speaker lists voice names (or voice IDs) in order of preference; the first one
your account has is used. 'python3 tools/voice/generate_vo.py --list-voices' shows
what's available. Settings: stability (lower = more expressive), similarity_boost,
style (exaggeration, 0 = off) and speed (0.7-1.2). The character notes are DESIGN.md §2.

DOT.note: Dot Amsel, 63, dispatcher: warm alto with a little gravel; precise radio cadence that loosens over the season.

THEO.note: Theo Marsh, 41, piano tuner: soft light baritone, unhurried, a smile in it; a bit formal on the radio at first.

CREW.note: The Harrow ground crew on a bad relay: gruff, clipped, outdoors.
